title: The Corrected Child — Characters and places to identify

entries.name: Valei
entries.known: Valei is Lio’s caregiver and participates in decisions about developmental support.
entries.unknown: Their exact family relationship, profession, and earlier life are not established.

entries.name: Vey (student)
entries.known: Vey is Lio’s classmate and construction partner.
entries.unknown: Their background remains undeveloped. Do not merge this student with other characters named Vey.

entries.name: Pei
entries.known: Pei is a classmate who participates more confidently with a defined responsibility.
entries.unknown: A fuller personal history and identity are not supplied.

entries.name: Arven
entries.known: Arven is a classmate associated with ambitious construction ideas.
entries.unknown: A fuller personal history and identity are not supplied.

entries.name: Developmental specialist with blue wrist bands
entries.known: One review specialist wears narrow blue wrist bands and speaks with careful precision.
entries.unknown: Their name is not reported to the reader; their affiliation and precise specialty remain unspecified. Both specialists introduce themselves, but Lio loses both names.
entries.quote: One wore narrow blue bands around their wrists

entries.name: Developmental specialist with diagrams
entries.known: The other review specialist brings a working surface covered in diagrams.
entries.unknown: Their name is not reported to the reader; their affiliation and precise specialty remain unspecified. Do not assume they are one of Lio’s original designers.
entries.quote: The other had brought a small working surface covered in diagrams

entries.name: House advocate
entries.known: The advocate participates in the review and adjusts Lio’s chair to make the record easier to see.
entries.unknown: Their personal name and the full scope of their institutional role are not established.

entries.name: Lio’s House of Learning
entries.known: The House is the educational setting containing Lio’s lessons and review.
entries.unknown: A proper institutional name and city or region are not established. No existing atlas location should be assigned without further evidence.

entries.name: Sen’s classroom
entries.known: An adaptive learning space includes collaborative construction and sensory adjustments.
entries.unknown: Its formal room name and position within the wider institution are not specified.

entries.name: Developmental review room
entries.known: The review takes place around a low oval table, with a shared record and a window overlooking the courtyard.
entries.unknown: The room has no established proper name or wider geographical location.

entries.name: Central courtyard
entries.known: The stories describe a central courtyard; Part Two describes suspended shades beyond the review-room window.
entries.unknown: Its proper name and wider geography are not established.

entries.name: Unused sensory studio
entries.known: Lio enters a sensory studio whose walls remain blank until activated.
entries.unknown: The studio has no established proper name or mapped position.

entries.name: Lio and Valei’s home
entries.known: The domestic setting includes a central room with adjustable stimulation, patterns, and projected scenery.
entries.unknown: Its address, settlement, and precise relation to the House are not established.

entries.name: Route to the House
entries.known: Lio and Valei walk to the House before the review.
entries.unknown: The route’s distance, landmarks, and geographical setting are not described.
